name: Discord Rich Presence for gosleep-timer
description: Add optional, non-blocking Discord Rich Presence for CLI and TUI timer phases.

userStories.title: Configure Discord Rich Presence
userStories.description: As a user, I want to configure and disable Discord Rich Presence so that I control whether gosleep-timer publishes my timer status.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a backward-compatible Discord configuration section with an enabled setting and Discord Application ID.
Presence is enabled by default, but no connection is attempted until a non-empty Application ID is configured.
Expose the enable toggle and Application ID through the existing TUI configuration editor.
Existing YAML configurations without the new section continue to load with defaults.
Add focused tests for defaults, old configuration deserialization, and editing/applying the new fields.
cargo fmt --check passes
cargo test --locked passes
cargo clippy --locked -- -D warnings passes
cargo build --release --locked passes
Isolated CLI smoke checks pass: initialize a temporary config, then run validate, status, and preview against it.

userStories.title: Add a non-blocking Discord presence client
userStories.description: As a user, I want gosleep-timer to connect to Discord's local Rich Presence interface so that my timer status appears when the Discord desktop client is available.
acceptanceCriteria: Use Discord local IPC for Rich Presence; do not add a bot token, network service, or account credentials.
Reuse or add the smallest maintained Rust dependency that supports the repository's Rust version; keep Cargo.lock committed.
A missing Discord client, unavailable IPC socket, or connection failure does not fail or stall a timer run.
Presence updates and cleanup do not block the countdown or action runner.
Add deterministic tests for presence payload formatting and the disabled/unconfigured no-op behavior.

userStories.title: Publish countdown status in CLI and TUI
userStories.description: As a user, I want Discord to show how long remains until the timer activates so that others can see when my sleep actions are due.
acceptanceCriteria: While running, show Sleep timer and a state such as 45m until sleep, with a countdown end timestamp where supported.
When paused, show a paused state and do not leave a stale countdown timestamp.
Show Power off after timer only when actions.power.mode is exactly poweroff; omit it for every other setting.
Support CLI run and TUI timer runs, including --no-actions and dry-run behavior.
Clear countdown presence when a run is stopped; transition to the post-countdown state on successful completion instead of clearing it.
Add tests for CLI/TUI status projection, paused status, remaining time, and poweroff visibility.

userStories.title: Publish post-countdown sleep status and document setup
userStories.description: As a user, I want Discord to show Sleeping for … after the timer activates so that the presence reflects the current phase.
acceptanceCriteria: After the countdown and configured actions complete, publish Sleeping for … with an elapsed-time timestamp measured from the start of post-countdown actions.
Keep the status accurate when actions fail; do not claim a sleep interval for --no-actions or dry-run runs.
Keep the elapsed status active in the TUI while it remains open and during the CLI wake-confirmation wait; let Discord clear it when the process exits or the machine powers off.
Clear presence when the run is cancelled or the application exits cleanly; retain the post-countdown status while the TUI remains open.
Document Discord Application ID setup, configuration keys, disable option, displayed states, and behavior when Discord is unavailable in README.md.
Add tests for transition to the post-countdown phase and cleanup on stop/completion.
